## 1b7191b100da

**Reproduced defect — selected task tests are not portable.** I ran the supported relocated task-test stage against generator SHA-256 `60e8c4d67e89c8ddc4fbf7595e81184a344b1bcf9a5c4c604d2598248f4488f0`. Result: 10 tests executed, 9 passed, 1 failed. `test_rule_hash_and_canonical_inputs_are_accepted` constructs `ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]` and then opens `ROOT / "data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl"`; in the portable runtime this becomes `/tmp/.../generators/1b7191b100da/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`, which does not exist.

Evidence: `checks/audit/1b7191b100da/task-tests-stage/result.json`, `checks/audit/1b7191b100da/task-tests-stage/checks/task_tests.xml`, and `checks/audit/1b7191b100da/task-tests-stage.log`.

This is a test/integration defect rather than evidence that the generator's marker-count semantics are wrong. I also inspected the generator's declared rivals and lesson-identifiability hook; the code explicitly covers fixed-count, marker-component-count, solid-bbox, separatorless, single-copy, and fixed-crop shortcuts. No source was changed because audit targets are report-only.
